<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Organisation" processRef="INCIDENT_PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="INCIDENT_PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_REPORTER" name="Employee or customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>START</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>REPORT</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_TRACKING" name="Tracking system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>LOG</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ASSIGN</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CLOSE</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>NOTIFY</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>END</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_TEAM" name="Responsible team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GATHER</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>IDENTIFY</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>PROPOSE</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>IMPLEMENT</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>FOLLOWUP</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="START" name="Incident occurs" />
    <bpmn:task id="REPORT" name="Report the incident" />
    <bpmn:task id="LOG" name="Log the report in the tracking system" />
    <bpmn:task id="ASSIGN" name="Assign the report to the appropriate team" />
    <bpmn:task id="GATHER" name="Gather the necessary information" />
    <bpmn:task id="IDENTIFY" name="Identify the cause of the incident" />
    <bpmn:task id="PROPOSE" name="Propose corrective actions" />
    <bpmn:task id="IMPLEMENT" name="Implement the solution" />
    <bpmn:task id="FOLLOWUP" name="Follow up to ensure the issue will not recur" />
    <bpmn:task id="CLOSE" name="Close the incident report" />
    <bpmn:task id="NOTIFY" name="Notify all stakeholders" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="END" name="Incident closed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="START" targetRef="REPORT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="REPORT" targetRef="LOG" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F3" sourceRef="LOG" targetRef="ASSIGN" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F4" sourceRef="ASSIGN" targetRef="GATHER" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F5" sourceRef="GATHER" targetRef="IDENTIFY" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F6" sourceRef="IDENTIFY" targetRef="PROPOSE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F7" sourceRef="PROPOSE" targetRef="IMPLEMENT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F8" sourceRef="IMPLEMENT" targetRef="FOLLOWUP" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F9" sourceRef="FOLLOWUP" targetRef="CLOSE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F10" sourceRef="CLOSE" targetRef="NOTIFY" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F11" sourceRef="NOTIFY" targetRef="END" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
